notes.title: Update v1.4: Specializations
notes.notes:
It’s been quite a bit! I will never get over how much love people have shown to this small game. To everyone who tried the game, to everyone who recommended the game, to everyone who made a youtube video, to everyone who left a review, to everyone who competed in the rankings for a high score: Thank you so, so very much. 

This game was made to share my passion for deck builders, card games and silly references. Maybe too many references, but can’t deny there is passion behind them.

Now, for today’s topic, the big update! 1.4 grew from a couple of quality of life fixes to much, much more.

General Changes:

 Added a new unlockable: Specializations! 51 of them, to be precise. These are perks you can grab before the run even starts, all of them with an upside and a downside, changing how the run goes.
 Ark points got turned into Gold, a currency you can get in game by defeating bosses! And as the Ark Points before, by getting achievements.
 All basic outfits are unlocked by default.
 Added 11 new fighters to the rival’s pool.
 A very basic tutorial was added for new players.
 Critical projectiles now have a different effect.
 Reworked the main menu.
 And the character creator.
 Several UI changes, actually.
 Added outlines to characters.


Balance:

 Buffed “The Hunt is on”.


Bugfixes:

 Added a perk that was missing from Magical Girl: Creative Mind.
 Trial of Wounds no longer allows you to remove wounds when removing cards.
 Now when a player leaves the name field empty it actually changes to “Protagonist”.

notes.title: Update v1.3.1: Projectiles Rework
notes.notes:
General Changes:

 Reworked pretty much all projectiles in the game. For real.
 The number of unique projectiles went from 59 to 203.


Balance Change:

 Getting negative HP due to Fire, Poison or Antihero now immediately triggers game over for both the protagonist and the rival.


Bugfixing:

 Fixed a bug where the Grow perk will give armor as well.
 Fixed a bug about the Grow, Overpowering and Keikaku perk not triggering due to gaining HP with another perk (Example: Trophy Collector).
 Capped the amount of fused cards into one during Endless Mode using the Keeper of Secrets backstory. This is because there is an edge case that could end up crashing the game.
 Updated Breaking the Limit description to better reflect how it works,
 Fixed negative HP breaking into 2 lines,
 Some typos.

notes.title: UPDATE v0.10: Endless Mode
notes.notes:
Have you ever played Tournament Ark and thought: "I wish I could play more than 20 fights per run"?
Well, I have great news for you! Introducing Endless Run, where now you can play for as long as you can survive!
The difficulty will keep on rising to insane levels. If you ever wanted to test how far your multi-fusion build can get you, this is the time!


General Changes

 Added the Endless Run Mode
 Added 20+ Trials, basically additional challenges that you get during Endless Run
 Added a system that keeps track of the rank you reach

Balance

General Changes

Balance Changes

 Breakthrough: Higher Critical Charge, now if you don't have a Mech gives you +2 Power Charges.
 Combine Robots: Base Power increased.
 Flying Module: Less Critical Charge, more Base Power.
 Get into the Robot: If you're already inside a Mech it advances the MK of your Mech. Now it has a base Power higher than 0.
 Laser Sword: Loses triple damage on crit. Now if you deal damage with this card it gives you 1 Haste charge.
 Missile Shower: Rarity reduced, now is more common.
 Transfer Energy to Shields: Rarity increased, now is more uncommon.
 Repropose Scrap: Power reduced to 0. Now if you're Outside a Mech it summons a Mech instead.
 The Ranger now haves only 1 healing potion in his deck.


Bugfixing

 The default victory and defeat animation no longer plays if you're inside a Mech.

notes.title: Update 0.9.9: Draft System
notes.notes:
General Changes

 Added a Draft System. Now you can draft the initial cards instead of having the default starting deck. (NOTE: This option unlocks after you win the game the first time. There is a toggle during Character Creation)
 Reworked how DOOM works, now it gets increased at the start of each turn, it can stack, is no longer irresistible using Hidden or resist perks, and it triggers when the DOOM reaches 10 or more, instead of when going to zero.
 Now you can randomize your Outfit if you're in the Customize Outfit tab, and randomizing the body doesn't overwrite the outfit anymore.


Balance

 Reduced the number of turns before the fight is over to 20.
 Chances have been adjusted. Now you will have at least 6 Fusion events per run. That way, Keeper of Secrets is less unreliable, for example.


Bugfixing

 Fixed a bug where you could get twice the same Boss Perk when exploring the Ark.
 Reflected attacks with On Dealing Damage effects now apply the effect correctly.
 Grammar corrections all around.

notes.title: Update v0.9.4: More Customization!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! It has been a couple of weeks without updates but I'm getting back to it. Big changes are coming! Also I'm working on adding a new Archetype to the game, with all that implies.

General Changes

 Added a new way of customizing your characters' outfits, allowing you more options.
 Now, whenever you defeat a boss 20 times, you unlock their outfits!
 Added the final "Main Menu" illustration! Now everyone can have a better idea of what the Ark looks like.
 When fusing "Apply Status" cards now the text with the amount of charges will stack instead of repeating the same lines multiple times.
 Added a new event to the Pool: Body-Building.
 Added 3 fighters to the roster.
 Adjusted the Vs. Screen.



Balance

 The "Maintenance" passive no longer removes Doom charges, since it tended to be more a detriment than a help.
 Removed "Icy Protection" and "Profit" from the pool of passives you can get in the "Explore the Ark" event.
 Fusing 2 cards of the same name will no longer level up the cards. This will be a soft nerf for fusing two "Block" cards, for example.


Bugfixing

 Fixed abnormalities in how copying the rival's status works (For example, the "We're not so different" card).
 Fixed a couple of lines of dialogue.
 Corrected some weirness on how the Audio settings worked.


Performance

 Improved the performance of fusing cards.
 The way Cold charges work is not slightly more performant.

notes.title: Update v0.9.1: Expanding Passives

 Added several new passives to the game: Skillful, Kata, Iron Muscles, Max Performance, Focused Mind, No Pain No Gain, Raising the Stakes, Draining Power, Energy Sink, Sellsword, Adrenaline Rush, All-Rounder, Bursting Flame, Perpetual Armor, Spiked Armor, Time Heals all Wounds, True Neutral, Maintenance, Mana Absorption, Thinking with Portals, Not Even my Final Form, No Mercy, I am the Night, Hypercharged and The Bet.
 Added art for 55 passives!
 Added feedback to the shuffle.


Balance:

 Weaken now reduces power by 50% instead of 25%, and "Secret Weakness" reduce it by 100%.
 All the passive pools of all the archetypes were expanded.
 Various buffs were applied to Pirate's passives.
 Nerfed "Battle Scars" from giving 50Hp to 30HP per wound.
 Buffed Flurry (Power reduction is now 40% instead of 50%).


Bugfixes:

 Fixed several complications with the "I've had Worst" passsive (Sorry!).
 Fixed a bug where fusing 2 consumable cards would result in the fused card losing the Consumable tag after a fight.
 Fixed some scenarios where you could have "0" charges of a status effect and still show visually.
 Fixed a very awkward bug where the new cards created by "Reckless" were hard to select.
 Added fix to prevent potential crashes when you beat a Boss.
 Added the missing icon from "Plot Armor".
 Fixed Guard Break and Breaking Point removing your own armor instead of your rival's.

notes.title: UPDATE V0.9: The final Archetype Reworked
notes.notes:

 Replaced all the art for wounds.

 All the wound cards now have a base power higher than 0.
 "Not just a scratch" now hurts the user by 5, in addition to the previous effect.
 The "I've worst" passive now applies the wound effects on the rival instead of on the user.

Bugfix

notes.title: Update V0.8.17: The Codex
notes.notes:
General Changes

 Added a Codex with all the characters! You unlock the entries by defeating them multiple times (Takes at least one new victory over a rival to show in the menu).
 Added the corresponding achievements for defeating each rival 20 times.
 Added a new state "During Clash" that executes right before the clash happens, but after most effects (Except the post-clash ones). They refer almost always to damage modifying effects, allowing different tactics and to have a better feedback on how the card was affected.
 When there is a "power-shift" during a clash now there is a feedback telling you exactly how much of a difference.
 "Defensive" cards no longer can get a "Lifesteal", "Decisive" or "Ignore Armor" tag.



Balance

 "Hacking" lose the "Defensive" tag and some of its base Power. The effect is now post-clash.
 Adjusted several rarities on the Technomancer Cards.
 Changed the starting cards for the Technomancer deck.


Bugfix

It was time for the Samurai to get a bit of a rework, in this patch we have:


 Reworked the Samurai's cards

notes.title: UPDATE 0.8.6: A long journey ahead
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! It's been a week since Tournament Ark was published on Steam, quite an exciting one for me! This is the first of many, many updates in a mostly weekly basis to bring the game to the so call "1.0". Without any more delays: What's different now?


Balance Changes:

 Nerfed "Perpetual Interdimensional Engine" from giving 3 Power per turn to 2
 Reduced the max amount of bosses' cards
 Changed the logic on how healing events show up during the run


Optimization

 Reduced 21% the file size of the game and memory use!


General Changes:

 Added options in-game to change "fullscreen" or change the resolution
 "Escape" now not only opens but closes the pause menu
 Changed the typography of the basic card's name
 Changed the blurry text on the fighters display
 Fixed some typos
 Minor visual fixes
 Added the version number to the hub


Bugfixing:

 Fixed a scenario where "Astral Projection" would also remove the positive status instead of just the negative ones
 Fixed the "Getting 0 bleed charges" from Blood Link



Thanks for joining this journey! I'll look forward to hear from all of you!
